title: LandParcel — LADM Profile
description: Profile that merges the OGC bblocks-land-parcels building block (ogc.ladm.land-parcels.parcel, https://github.com/ogcincubator/bblocks-land-parcels) with LADM LA_SpatialUnit. The LandParcel ontology (https://w3id.org/ogc/ladm/parcels/) already treats Parcel as a subclass of 3DSpatialUnit (LA_SpatialUnit) and is grounded in the LADM/CSDM model, so the two schemas compose naturally. Key design decisions: (1) Topology — 'topology.references' (OGC ogc-utils.topology building block) is the single boundary representation; each reference IRI identifies an LA_BoundaryFaceString feature. The BFS feature carries left/right unit adjacency — the parcel does not need to repeat it. 'topology.relationships' is dropped; feature-level containment/adjacency relations use OGC API 'links' instead. (2) Interests → RRR — LandParcel 'interests[]' maps directly to LADM RRR: 'interestLink' is the LA_RRR FeatureRef; 'interestType' the rrrType CodeListRef. Both plain URIs and structured FeatureRef objects are accepted for link properties. (3) Purpose/Use — 'parcelPurpose' CURIE (LandParcel) is replaced by LADM 'landUse' CodeListRef to avoid dual-vocabulary redundancy; 'parcelType' and 'parcelState' CURIEs are kept as they have no direct LADM equivalent. (4) Appellation — from 'ogc.bbr.utils.compoundName' building block; subproperty of 'com:name' in the LandParcel ontology.

allOf.$comment: BASE: LADM LA_SpatialUnit (JSON-FG 1.0.0 + VersionedObject + representationType). Provides: place, geometry, coordRefSys, time, featureType, suID, dimension, representationType, area[], landUse, spatialSource, lifespanVersion.

EXTENSION: OGC LandParcel building block properties (ogc.ladm.land-parcels.parcel inline). Appellation from ogc.bbr.utils.compoundName; interests[] from LandParcel 'interest' $def mapped to LADM RRR; topology from ogc.ogc-utils.topology. 'links' follows OGC API Features pattern for parcel-to-territory containment relations.

links.description: OGC API Features links for feature-level relationships: containment in administrative/cadastral units, alternate representations, and canonical self-link. Replaces the former 'topology.relationships' array which conflated topology with feature relationships. Link relation types from the OGC name server (https://www.opengis.net/def/rel/ogc/1.0/) are preferred.

topology.description: Topological boundary representation using the OGC Topology building block (ogc.ogc-utils.topology). 'references' is an ordered list of IRIs identifying the directed LA_BoundaryFaceString features that form the closed boundary ring(s) of this parcel. Direction follows the right-hand rule: the parcel interior is to the left of each directed curve. Adjacency (which parcel is on the other side of each edge) is encoded on the LA_BoundaryFaceString features via 'leftUnit'/'rightUnit' — not on this parcel. This is the single boundary topology representation; 'properties.boundaryFaceStrings' is not used in this profile (those FeatureRefs are superseded by the IRI-based references here).

references.description: Ordered ring(s) of LA_BoundaryFaceString IRIs. Each inner array is one ring; the first ring is the exterior boundary. Items are IRIs resolvable via the cadastral API or relative to the base URI declared in the feature collection.

appellation.description: Compound name / formal parcel identifier decomposed into typed name parts. Building block: ogc.bbr.utils.compoundName (LandParcel bblocks). Ontology mapping: subproperty of 'com:name' in the LandParcel ontology (https://w3id.org/ogc/ladm/parcels/). Captures the jurisdictional naming scheme (plan type, plan number, parcel type, parcel identifier, cadastral municipality, etc.) more expressively than 'suID'. Both may be present: 'suID' is the machine-readable registry ID; 'appellation' is the decomposed legal name.

label.description: Full human-readable label (e.g. 'k.č. 1234/5 k.o. Trnje', 'Lot 1 DP 572532')

hasPart.description: Name parts in declaration order, each with a type role understood by the jurisdiction

type.description: Role of this name part (e.g. CadastralMunicipality, ParcelType, ParcelIdentifier, PlanType, PlanIdentifier, BuildingLevel)

parcelType.description: Parcel classification as an IRI or CURIE code reference. LandParcel ontology property: parcel:type, range ParcelType. Distinguishes e.g. allotment, road, water, stratum (3D). Example IRI: 'https://cadastre.gov.hr/codelist/parcelType/regularParcel'.

parcelState.description: Current lifecycle state as an IRI or CURIE. LandParcel ontology property: parcel:state, range ParcelState. Lifecycle history is captured in 'lifespanVersion' and 'time'; this field records the explicit codelist state. Example: 'https://cadastre.gov.hr/codelist/parcelState/historical'.

interests.description: Legal interests affecting this parcel. LandParcel building block 'interest' $def; ontology type: parcel:LandInterest, which corresponds to LADM LA_RRR (Right, Restriction, Responsibility). This array is a lightweight embedded read-delivery view — suitable for responses that need parcel + encumbrances without client traversal. For write/update operations, use LADM submission packages with separate LA_Right/LA_Restriction/LA_Responsibility objects. The 'interestLink' field is the canonical identifier of the corresponding LA_RRR object in the cadastral API.

interestLink.description: Reference to the LA_RRR object. Accepts a plain URI string (LandParcel bblock format) or a structured FeatureRef object (LADM format) — both identify the same cadastral API resource.

oneOf.description: URI of the LA_RRR object (LandParcel CURIE/IRI format)

interestName.description: Human-readable name of the interest (e.g. 'Vlasništvo', 'Mortgage', 'Right of Way')

interestType.description: Interest type as IRI/CURIE. Maps to LADM rrrType (right/restriction/responsibility) + type CodeListRef. Example: 'https://cadastre.gov.hr/codelist/interestType/ownership'.

dateInForce.description: Date the interest became active. Maps to LA_RRR.timeSpec start.

dateExpires.description: Date the interest expires (absent for perpetual rights). Maps to LA_RRR.timeSpec end.

statuteLink.description: IRI of the statute / legal instrument authorising this interest. Maps to LA_AdministrativeSource reference.

benefitedPartyName.description: Display name of the party holding the interest. Maps to LA_Party.name.

benefitedPartyLink.description: Reference to the LA_Party object. Accepts a plain URI string or a structured FeatureRef.

originalSurveyLink.description: Reference to the LA_SpatialSource that established this interest's spatial extent. Accepts URI or FeatureRef.

referencedParcel.description: Parcel that is the subject of this interest (for secondary/easement parcels). IRI or FeatureRef.

burdenedParcels.description: Parcels burdened by this interest (e.g. dominant tenement in an easement)

benefitedParcels.description: Parcels that benefit from this interest

entitlementPortion.description: Ownership share as a fraction string (e.g. '1/2', '1/1'). Maps to LA_RRR.share (Fraction).
